name: ppse
description:
bunnylol ppse til <optional:search_string>

    bunnylol ppse grp <optional:search_string>

    bunnylol ppse wiki <optional:payment_provider>
    Possible values for payment_provider are
    wa: Whatsapp
    k/kbank : kbank
    adyen : adyen
    shopify : shopiy
    payu : payu
    pp/paypal nmor : Paypal NMor
    paypal mor : Paypal Mor
    pwm : Pay with Meta

    bunnylol ppse unidash/ud/dash/dashboard <optional:string>
    Possible values for string
    wa: for whatsapp partner tracker
    k/kbank : for kbank partner tracker

    bunnylol ppse ao/oc/alerts/a/oncall

    bunnylol ppse to/ot

    bunnylol ppse shift/shifts/s

    bunnylol ppse sf <optional:string>
     Possible values for string
     caseid,account, app, page etc

    bunny lol ppse support/supp

    bunnylol ppse dr/drive/d/gd <optional:file_identifier>
      Possible values for file_identifier are below
      sr/sev : for sev review file in drive
      tm/teammeet/meet : for team meeting file in drive
      pit/partner/pt/tracker : for partner tracker file in drive

    bunnylol ppse 1/1d/oned/one <optional:search_folder_identifier>
      Possible values for search_folder_identifier are below
      k/kbank : For KBANK search folder in one detection
      wa : For Whatsapp search folder in one detection
      paypal/pp : For Paypal search folder in one detection
      shopify : For Shopify search folder in one detection
      payu : For PayU search folder in one detection
      adyen : For Adyen search folder in one detection


    bunnylol ppse scuba <optional:dataset_abbrv>
    Possible values for dataset_abbrv are as following:
    npe : for nmor payment engine
    pbr : for payment backend reliability
    pbrm : for payment backend reliability metrics
    pbu : for payment backend upi
    ppr : for payment partner reliability
    curl/c : curl fetcher
    upl : for upl events core

    bunnylol ppse <tool_abbrv> <string arg>
    Possible values for tool_abbrv is
    cx : for payment context
    wer : for provider error code mnagement tool

    Note : Defaults to searching in intern for ppse

      o2o MODEL_TYPE MODEL_ID
      o2o MODEL_ID

      o2o MODEL_TYPE

      Usage #3: Redirect to Feature Inconsistency for given model type and model ID.
      o2o f MODEL_TYPE MODEL_ID

      Usage #3: Redirect to Data Inconsistency for given model type and model ID.
      o2o l MODEL_TYPE MODEL_ID

      Usage #4: Redirect to Prediction Inconsistency for given model type and model ID.
      o2o p MODEL_TYPE MODEL_ID

      Usage #5: Redirect to NE waterfall debugging for given universe and version ids

      Tier Level(Possible values) - l1,l2,l3
      Region(Possible Values) - sgp,mpk,dub
      Details and examples :
      To get all cases for a particular user : dseq <unixname> OR just dseq for yourself.
      To get a list of cases for a particular tier : dseq <Tier Level> e.g. dseq l1 or dseq l2 or dseq l3.
      To get a list of cases for a particular tier and for a particular regiion use dseq <Tier Level> <Region> : dseq l1 sgp or dseq l2 mpk
      N.B: An invalid office in the second argument(Region) will default to returning all offices

name: hwk2
description:
## hwk WORKFLOW [ARGS ...]
We pass control to the WORKFLOW's genRedirect methods.
Example: `hwk ig [ARGS ...]`

## hwk ENTITY
We try to parse the ENTITY and redirect you to a suitable Workflow.
Examples:
- hwk MODEL_TYPE_NAME
  - `hwk adindexer_ctr_mobilefeed_model`
  - `hwk offsite_cvr_model`
- hwk MODEL_SERIES_ID
  - `hwk 557003969`
- hwk FEATURE
  - `hwk F3_ADFINDER_USER_ADS_SEARCH_ADS_USER_CONTEXT_FEATURES_SEARCH_QUERY_TAGGER_PAGE_CATEGORY`
  - `hwk asset://ai.feature/ADS/F3_ADPUBLISHER_ADS_EMERGING_SURFACES_REALTIME_EXPLODED_F3_ADS_ENTITY_EQUIVALENCE_KEY_SUM_2_PAGE_TYPE_70_IMPRESSION`
  - `hwk 230173946`
- hwk AOS_CATEGORY
  - `hwk AD_FINDER_CACHE_ADS_INFRA`

In case of conflicts, precedence follows the ordering above (e.g., MODEL_SERIES_ID beats FEATURE). To avoid conflicts, see below.

## hwk NUDGE ENTITY
You supply a NUDGE to guide us in the right direction.
Examples:
- `hwk [feature|feat] FEATURE`
- `hwk mis MODEL_SERIES_ID`
- `hwk model MODEL_SERIES_ID`
- `hwk [ma|md] MIS_ANALYSIS_ID`
- `hwk roam MODEL_SERIES_ID`
- `hwk roam MODEL_TYPE_NAME`

## mhh ENTITY
Redirects to Model Health Hub. Search Model Health Hub by given model ID/Type Name(s).
Examples:
- `mhh MODEL_ID(s)`
- `mhh MODEL_NAME(s)`
  - `mhh mtml_ctr_instagram_model dh_post_match_mobile_cvr_model`
  - `mhh aimai igctr` same as the above by using model type acronyms.

Otherwise, it will search for the query. i.e. "gh foobar" -> github.com/search?q=foobar. If you include the option "i" (for internal) in front of the repo name, and the argument that follows resolves to a known, Facebook, open source repo, the bunnylol command will navigate to that repo directly. ie. "gh i facehub" -> github.com/facebookincubator/facehub instead of github.com/facehub (which is a different project entirely).

name: bsef
description:
bunnylol ppse til <optional:search_string>

    bunnylol ppse grp <optional:search_string>

    bunnylol ppse wiki <optional:payment_provider>
    Possible values for payment_provider are
    wa: Whatsapp
    k/kbank : kbank
    adyen : adyen
    shopify : shopiy
    payu : payu
    pp/paypal nmor : Paypal NMor
    paypal mor : Paypal Mor
    pwm : Pay with Meta

    bunnylol ppse unidash/ud/dash/dashboard <optional:string>
    Possible values for string
    wa: for whatsapp partner tracker
    k/kbank : for kbank partner tracker

    bunnylol ppse ao/oc/alerts/a/oncall

    bunnylol ppse to/ot

    bunnylol ppse shift/shifts/s

    bunnylol ppse sf <optional:string>
     Possible values for string
     caseid,account, app, page etc

    bunny lol ppse support/supp

    bunnylol ppse dr/drive/d/gd <optional:file_identifier>
      Possible values for file_identifier are below
      sr/sev : for sev review file in drive
      tm/teammeet/meet : for team meeting file in drive
      pit/partner/pt/tracker : for partner tracker file in drive

    bunnylol ppse 1/1d/oned/one <optional:search_folder_identifier>
      Possible values for search_folder_identifier are below
      k/kbank : For KBANK search folder in one detection
      wa : For Whatsapp search folder in one detection
      paypal/pp : For Paypal search folder in one detection
      shopify : For Shopify search folder in one detection
      payu : For PayU search folder in one detection
      adyen : For Adyen search folder in one detection


    bunnylol ppse scuba <optional:dataset_abbrv>
    Possible values for dataset_abbrv are as following:
    npe : for nmor payment engine
    pbr : for payment backend reliability
    pbrm : for payment backend reliability metrics
    pbu : for payment backend upi
    ppr : for payment partner reliability
    curl/c : curl fetcher
    upl : for upl events core

    bunnylol ppse <tool_abbrv> <string arg>
    Possible values for tool_abbrv is
    cx : for payment context
    wer : for provider error code mnagement tool

    Note : Defaults to searching in intern for ppse

name: dseqm
description:
Takes one or two argument depending on the use case
      Tier Level(Possible values) - l1,l2,l3
      Region(Possible Values) - sgp,mpk,dub
      Details and examples :
      To get all cases for a particular user : dseq <unixname> OR just dseq for yourself.
      To get a list of cases for a particular tier : dseq <Tier Level> e.g. dseq l1 or dseq l2 or dseq l3.
      To get a list of cases for a particular tier and for a particular regiion use dseq <Tier Level> <Region> : dseq l1 sgp or dseq l2 mpk
      N.B: An invalid office in the second argument(Region) will default to returning all offices
